title: AROH Legal & Regulatory Review Register
governing_statutes: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act)
Information Technology Act, 2000 & applicable intermediary guidelines

items.decision_required: Formal legal entity name, corporate identification (CIN/LLPIN), and registered office address for Data Fiduciary declaration under Section 5 notice requirements
items.current_assumption: Placeholder identifier '[AROH_LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME]' utilized; entity in formation or operating under founder sponsorship
items.risk: Statutory notice invalidity if registered corporate entity details are omitted prior to commercial production processing
items.required_legal_confirmation: Confirm official company incorporation details, registered address, and official corporate registration numbers

items.decision_required: Designation, contact email, and escalation mechanism of the statutory Grievance Redressal Officer under Section 13 DPDP Act and Rule 14 DPDP Rules 2025
items.current_assumption: Configurable contact 'grievance@aroh.in' and placeholder '[GRIEVANCE_OFFICER_NAME]'; response SLA configured to 30 days (well within 90-day statutory maximum)
items.risk: Regulatory penalties under DPDP Act Schedule for failure to establish operational grievance redressal mechanism
items.required_legal_confirmation: Officially designate employee or legal representative as statutory Grievance Officer and verify public contact channels

items.decision_required: Assessment of whether AROH qualifies as a 'Significant Data Fiduciary' (SDF) under Section 10 DPDP Act (based on volume/sensitivity of data, risk to electoral democracy, sovereignty, or public order)
items.current_assumption: AROH is an open-source application ecosystem with modest initial volume; does NOT currently meet criteria for SDF designation, hence independent Data Protection Officer (DPO) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA) are treated as FUTURE_READY rather than mandatory now
items.risk: Non-compliance with SDF obligations (mandatory local DPO, periodic DPIA, statutory audit) if designated by Central Government
items.required_legal_confirmation: Confirm non-SDF status under current user volume and establish trigger thresholds for future re-evaluation

items.decision_required: Verification mechanism for parental consent regarding users under 18 years of age pursuant to Section 9 DPDP Act and DPDP Rules 2025
items.current_assumption: Platform is primarily intended for general audience, developers, and adult professionals (18+); minors under 18 are prohibited from autonomous account creation without verifiable parental authorization; zero behavioral tracking or targeted advertising across entire platform
items.risk: Strict statutory liability for processing child data without verifiable parental consent or performing prohibited tracking
items.required_legal_confirmation: Confirm age assurance approach and acceptable methods of verifying parental authority under final notified rules

items.decision_required: Legality of international data transfers to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) / Firebase and Vercel infrastructure located outside India
items.current_assumption: Section 16 DPDP Act permits cross-border transfer unless restricted by Central Government negative list ('blacklisting' approach); Central Government has not notified restrictive countries prohibiting transfers to US/EU for standard hosting; data processing addenda executed with cloud vendors
items.risk: Transfer violation if Central Government issues restricted country notifications impacting US cloud data centers
items.required_legal_confirmation: Monitor Gazette notifications under Section 16(1) and verify cloud vendor localization capabilities if required

items.decision_required: Legal classification of Aros tokens (in-platform utility credits vs. stored value vs. virtual digital assets under Indian tax / RBI guidelines)
items.current_assumption: Aros tokens are closed-loop, non-transferable, non-cashable in-platform utility reward points used solely for membership unlocks and platform feature access; no peer-to-peer trading or fiat redemption
items.risk: Unintended regulatory scrutiny under RBI Prepaid Payment Instrument (PPI) or VDA tax regulations if secondary market develops
items.required_legal_confirmation: Confirm closed-loop utility exemption and validate Terms of Service prohibition on commercial resale or monetary cashout

items.decision_required: Confirming terms of service with third-party LLM providers (OpenAI / Anthropic / Google) regarding whether user prompts are utilized for model training
items.current_assumption: Only commercial API endpoints are utilized which explicitly guarantee zero data retention for training; default development environment uses local mock orchestrator
items.risk: Misrepresentation to Data Principals if consumer-grade LLM interfaces with training retention are accidentally configured
items.required_legal_confirmation: Audit commercial API agreements to certify zero-training retention across all configured model providers

items.decision_required: Enforceability of liability limitations, disclaimer of warranties, and indemnification clauses under Indian Contract Act, 1872 and Consumer Protection Act, 2019
items.current_assumption: Standard SaaS liability cap (limited to amounts paid in preceding 12 months or INR 1,000); explicit non-waiver of non-excludable statutory privacy rights under DPDP Act
items.risk: Unenforceability of liability caps in consumer dispute tribunals
items.required_legal_confirmation: Review clause enforceability against recent Indian consumer protection jurisprudence
